mechanism_narrative: Increasing GDP indicates strong economic activity, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over 60 days in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer confidence and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate remains below 3.5% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When federal funds rate is high and unemployment is low, it may indicate tight monetary policy, negatively affecting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Federal funds rate and unemployment rate combination does not predict negative S&P 500 returns in 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, high federal funds rate predicts lower S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase.
failure_condition: High federal funds rate in tightening cycle does not correlate with negative S&P 500 returns.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates increased economic output, positively influencing S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Industrial production growth does not lead to positive S&P 500 returns in 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong demand in the housing market, boosting related sectors and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Housing starts exceed 1300 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment and retail sales increase together, it signals strong economic activity, positively affecting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Positive payroll and retail sales do not correlate with positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.

mechanism_narrative: In an inflationary regime, high CPI suggests increased consumer prices, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns as costs rise.
failure_condition: High CPI in inflationary regime does not predict negative S&P 500 returns.
